title: Sticky vignettes and implementation sproutlist (customer threads + quick probes)
content:
Purpose
This is a lightweight synthesis of ~25 recent customer threads (support, CSM notes, sales handoffs) focused on recurring friction points that keep resurfacing. Goal: capture small, high-velocity probes we can ship in 1-2 sprints that materially reduce support volume and unblock developer integrations.

Quick summary / headline signals
- Prefix caching confusion: multiple customers (mid-market SaaS and two fintechs) think Redwood caches user prompts persistently across requests; expectations vary on TTL and visibility.
- Model variant fallbacks causing subtle behavior deltas: customers observe quality regressions when the platform routes to quantized or smaller variants during bursts. They call it a "voice shift" in responses.
- Token accounting surprises: customers integrating server-side streaming see mismatch between token-based billing and their internal metrics when partial streams or aborted responses occur.
- Rollout observability gap: engineers want a way to replay a single request across rollout variants (canary vs baseline) to inspect divergence quickly.
- Onboarding friction for private deployments: networking/KMS docs are fine in theory but customers hit order-of-operations traps (policy attachment timing + VPC peering) that delay deployments by days.

Sticky vignettes (short customer stories)
1) BlueBank (mid-size fintech) — "cached PII" scare
- Context: Using Redwood Private for KYC prompt enrichment. One engineer reported an audit flag after seeing a downstream log with tokens matching a prior customer's prompt (turned out to be a concatenation artifact in their logging).
- Why sticky: raised compliance alarm; customer paused rollout until we can articulate cache isolation guarantees.
- Suggested probe: one-pager "cache isolation guarantees" + add a toggleable debug header that returns cache-hit metadata (per-request, short-lived) for private deployments.

2) LocaleMaps (SaaS) — "voice shift" during high load
- Context: They use hosted API with reserved capacity and occasional burst. During bursts, requests routed to a quantized variant returned terser, less detailed outputs.
- Why sticky: perceived model regressions triggered rollback of a release; engineering wasn't sure if config or autoscaling triggered it.
- Suggested probe: add a per-request response-quality fingerprint (n-gram overlap proxy + length + top-p delta) for quick triage in Console traces.

3) Promptly (startup) — token math mismatch
- Context: They stream tokens to client and close socket early on many requests. Their aggregator billing shows more tokens than what client reported.
- Why sticky: undermines trust in per-token billing; CS escalated.
- Suggested probe: publish a short doc on streaming semantics + a debug flag that emits final token accounting in the response envelope.

Candidate quick fixes (1-2 sprint scope)
- Docs + short FAQs (low effort):
  * "Streaming billing: what you see vs what we count" (include examples of aborted streams, partial responses, and how prefix caching affects counts). Owner: Docs + Billing SME.
  * "Cache isolation: what to expect in Private and Dedicated" (clear language, diagrams). Owner: Private PM.
- Console UX + trace enhancements (medium):
  * Add a "replay to variants" button in request traces (capture same request, run on baseline/canary/quantized clones in a sandboxed environment, show diff). Minimal v1: only for hosted API; gated by cost/limits. Owner: Console eng + applied-ml.
  * Expose token-accounting field in trace details (finalized after request completion). Owner: Observability.
- Runtime feature toggles (low-medium):
  * Expose a debug header for per-request cache metadata (hit/miss, TTL remaining, isolation id). Implement in Dedicated/Private first. Owner: Serving-runtime.
  * Add response-quality fingerprint tags in traces to highlight when model-variant routing materially changes outputs (n-gram proxy). Owner: Applied-ML.

Risk notes / tradeoffs
- Any per-request debug tracer or replay facility increases surface for PII leakage; must be redacted by default and only available to org admins. Coordinate with Security & Privacy.
- Replay to variants consumes tokens and compute — need quota guardrails and cost attribution path for customers.

Prioritization heuristics applied here
- Safety/compliance-sparking issues (BlueBank) get high weight — one blocking customer is worth pushing docs + safe debug sooner.
- Trust/transactional plumbing (billing/token math) has high churn impact — advice + small console instrumentation prioritized.
- Perceived quality regressions affect adoption velocity; probes should be low-friction and allow root-cause (routing vs model) resolution.

Concrete next steps (owner & ETA)
- Owner: Maya Patel (CS) to draft two short explainers and circulate. ETA: 2026-04-29 (doc drafts).
- Owner: Ethan Cole (Observability) to prototype token-accounting field and debug header ingestion in traces (internal feature flag). ETA: prototype 2026-05-13.
- Owner: Louise Zhang (Applied ML) to design a lightweight response fingerprint metric + guide for thresholds. ETA: 2026-05-20.
- Owner: Ravi Menon (Private PM) to produce a one-page checklist for private deployment ordering (KMS order, peering, IAM) and triage playbook. ETA: 2026-05-06.

Open questions / things to validate with customers
- Would customers accept a per-request debug header in response if it included cache metadata (hit/miss, isolation id) if it required admin-only access? Who signs off? (Legal + Security)
- For replay: is a cost-based gating model acceptable (e.g., 10 free replays/month + charge after)? Ask Field for thresholds.
- Fingerprint usefulness: does n-gram overlap + length correlate enough with perceived "voice shift"? Need small blind A/B with 3 customers to validate.

Notes to self (raw fragments)
- Reach out to CS owners for BlueBank + LocaleMaps; offer to run guided trace session w/ console team.
- Collect 6 example requests that triggered billing mismatch; add to repo with redaction.
- Slack thread: #cs-field-signals has more raw logs (link above).

Appendix: quick checklist for a 2-sprint probe package
- Draft two explainers (billing + cache isolation) (Docs owner)
- Implement debug header + token-accounting field behind feature flag (Observability + Runtime)
- Create 3 small customer pilots (BlueBank, LocaleMaps, Promptly) for guided validation (CS)
- Draft privacy/PII mitigation for debug headers and replay flows (Security review)

End notes
Keep this as a living file; I'll update after the first customer pilot (target mid-May). If we get signoff for a replay prototype, we'll need a short customer-facing FAQ and explicit quota/cost table.
